title: load_signing_key_from_bytes test uses code as own oracle
description: crates/core/src/signing.rs test load_signing_key_from_bytes_accepts_32_bytes generates a key, converts to bytes, reloads, and compares .to_bytes() == .to_bytes(). This is a roundtrip using the code under test as its own oracle — it proves only that the function is idempotent, not correct. A known test vector (e.g. 32 zero bytes → expected public key derived from external reference) is required per test integrity rules.
